recipes.description: The baseline MLA conversion with no auxiliary prediction head.

metadata.name: transformer-mla-mla
metadata.description: Continue one Transformer MLA topology (the baseline MLA conversion with no auxiliary prediction head) under an authority-owned TrainVM lease, gated on held-out next-token evidence published at the attempt baseline before the first optimizer mutation.

acquire_gpu.description: Take the exclusive accelerator lease this continuation runs under.

train.description: One bounded MLA continuation. Publishes its attempt-baseline held-out next-token evidence, bound to a baseline checkpoint, before the first optimizer mutation.

release_gpu.description: Return the accelerator lease however the continuation ended.

overrides.name: model.path
overrides.description: Exact local Hugging Face model snapshot to convert
